 Hon'Ble Avnish Saxena, J. 
1.
Supplementary affidavit filed today is taken on record.

2. Heard Sri Shashank Sharma, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Sumit Kumar Gaur, learned Advocate holding brief of learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 and learned A.G.A. for State.
3.

The instant application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been moved with a prayer to quash the charge sheet dated 15.07.2023 and cognizance order dated 09.08.2023 as well as entire proceedings of Criminal Case No.40118 of 2023 (State Vs. Phool Chandra), arising out of Case Crime No.213 of 2023, under Sections 376, 504, 506 IPC, Police Station Peepiganj, District Gorakhpur, pending in the court of Fast Track Court 1st/District and Session Judge, Gorakhpur.
4.

sentences.text: Learned counsel appears for the applicant submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated by the opposite party no.2 for the offence of rape on false pretext of marriage.
Later on, applicant and opposite party no.2 entered into marriage.
The marriage certificate is filed at page no.7 in affidavit dated 05.03.2025.
There is a compromise between the parties.

5. Learned counsel appears for the opposite party no.2 has admitted the factum of compromise between the parties and further admits that the applicant and opposite party no.2 are living together as husband and wife.
6. There is no point in getting the trial continued, when the parties have buried their differences as the star witness would not support the prosecution case.
7. Thus, the proceeding arose out of case crime number mentioned above is hereby quashed.
Consequently, the proceedings of trial also quashed.
8. The application U/s 482 Cr.P.C. is allowed accordingly.
